components.css: .ds-card-project { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e6dfd5; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card-project:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-badge-cat { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Newsreader Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; margin: 0.5rem 0; } .ds-card-impact { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #c84b2c; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b03e22; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #faf8f5; border-color: #0f172a; }

narrative.overview: Hands Across Humanity combines documentary authenticity with enterprise-grade commercial non-profit authority. The design system rejects generic non-profit templates in favor of radical field transparency, warm tactile materials, and precise financial clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Editorial Tone: Warm alabaster and cream sand backgrounds paired with editorial serif typography.
High-Trust Action Accents: Vibrant Terracotta Ember for direct action paired with Emerald Green for verified impact metrics.
Tactile Card Architecture: Crisp white elevated cards with 12px rounded corners, precise micro-borders, and smooth lift states.
Radical Transparency Layouts: Dual-action cards featuring prominent progress bars and audit partner attestations.

rules.name: The Terracotta Focus Rule
rules.body: Primary Terracotta Ember (#C84B2C) is reserved exclusively for interactive calls to action and primary focal points. It never covers more than 10% of any screen viewport.

rules.name: The Emerald Proof Rule
rules.body: Emerald (#059669) is strictly bound to factual outcomes, verified metrics, audit badges, and completed goal indicators.

rules.name: The Optical Serif Rule
rules.body: All headings (h1-h3) use Newsreader Variable with explicit font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 36 to ensure optimal contrast and stroke proportion.

rules.name: The Responsive Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation shadows intensify only on interactive cards and elevated modals upon hover or focus state.

dos: Do maintain strict color role separation: Terracotta Ember for actions, Emerald for metrics/proofs, Slate for text.
Do use responsive type scales (clamp()) and font-variation-settings: 'opsz' for variable serif headings.
Do pair project cards with real field photographs, location indicators, and explicit audit partner names.
Do provide keyboard-accessible modal dialogs and filter controls with clean focus rings.
donts: Don't use pure stark black (#000000) for text or backgrounds; always use Midnight Slate (#0F172A) or Body Slate (#1E293B).
Don't place generic non-profit placeholder icons; use documentary imagery and verified field data.
Don't overcrowd card layouts; maintain generous internal padding (1.5rem) and clear spatial separation.
Don't break pagination grid bounds during filtering; hide out-of-filter cards smoothly using CSS transitions.
